# Burford CEO quoted extensively in GAR-LCIA report on arbitration


- International arbitration


November 13, 2024


-
-
-
-


Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) participated in a GAR-LCIA roundtable earlier this year entitled “Is it time for a reset?” GAR describes the roundtable and the subsequent report in an article, where Bogart is quoted. The full report can be viewed[here](https://files.lbr.cloud/public/2024-11/GAR%20-%20LCIA%20Roundtable%20in%20full%2C%20final.pdf?VersionId=sv8MFzSCeO4LwkmzlGc3ZVUm3mDTjKDz) .


[Click here to read the full article.](https://globalarbitrationreview.com/article/proactive-case-management-consequences-recommendations-the-gar-lcia-roundtable)
